subject: Status check on Redwood evaluation — next steps or offramp
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Rao <anika@talltree.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 04 Sep 2025 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps from today's discovery — Redwood inference

Hi Anika,

Thanks again for taking the time today — enjoyed the discussion about TallTree's latency-sensitive summarization workload and the regulatory constraints you mentioned for client data. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

- Current pain: unpredictable per-token cost and late spikes during batch runs.
- What we can help with: Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput, prefix/KV caching to reduce token usage, and private deployment options for data residency.
- Proposed technical next step: 1-hour pilot run with a 2-node dedicated pool; we'll provide a short config recipe and success metrics template.
- Commercials: rough estimate attached (very preliminary) — we can refine after pilot results.

Would you be able to confirm: (a) willingness to run a 1-week pilot in Staging, (b) who on your infra side we should loop in for credentials/network, and (c) a target date for the pilot start?

I've attached the Redwood Quickstart guide and a one-pager on dedicated pools. If it's helpful, Marissa can jump on a short technical sync with your infra team.

Thanks — I can be flexible on timing next week.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193
Redwood Inference

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's discovery — Redwood inference

Hi Anika —

Just nudging on the pilot question below. I haven't heard back and wanted to make sure my note didn't get lost. Proposed start windows: Sep 15–19 or Sep 22–26. Either works on our side; we can compress kickoff to a 30-min setup if that helps.

If you'd like, here's a single-slide checklist you can forward to your infra team: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBCdEfGH/view?usp=sharing

If you're not the right contact for the pilot logistics, can you point me to the person who owns infra/networking?

Thanks,
--
Soojin
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Rao <anika@talltree.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check — is this still a priority for TallTree?

Hi Anika —

Wanted to check in quickly: do you still plan to run the Staging pilot with Redwood this month? I know priorities shift and budgets tighten — if the timing has moved, totally understand. In that case, would you prefer we: 

- pause the conversation until Q1 2026, or
- keep the file open and I follow up in 3–4 weeks, or
- move to a procurement/PO conversation if Procurement is ready (I can pull together a minimal SOW).

If helpful, I've attached an updated, budget-friendly pilot option (1 node, 3-day run) that lowers initial cost and should surface the same quality/latency signals.

Either way, a quick reply with a one-line preference will help me keep things organized on our end.

Appreciate it,

--
Soojin

[Attachment: proposed-mop-updated.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Rao <anika@talltree.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Closing the loop — should I close the file?

Hi Anika —

Hope you're well. I haven't received a reply to the pilot options or timing notes — wanted to close the loop on our side. If you remain interested, we'd be happy to get the 3-day, single-node pilot scheduled in a matter of days. If priorities have shifted, is it OK if I close this outreach on Sep 25? You're welcome to re-open at any time and we'll pick up where we left off.

If I don't hear back, I'll mark the opportunity as paused in our CRM next Friday. No hard feelings — just want to keep our pipeline tidy.

Thanks for the transparency either way.

Best,

--
